figures.caption: Fig. 1: Comparison of SAM-based adaptations for medical image segmentation. Unlike other prompting strategies, our EP-SAM enhances the synergy of individual components and explicitly alleviates boundary ambiguity.

Fig. 2: Overview of EP-SAM with two key modules: an edge-aware module that enhances contour modeling and a prompt enhanced module that injects coarse-to-fine mask priors for enhancing synergy of individual components.
Fig. 3: Generalization performance (Dice %) on three unseen ultrasound datasets (DDTI [23], UDIAT [2], HMC-QU [8]).

TABLE I: Quantitative results comparing our method with prior approaches on TN3K, BUSI, and CAMUS benchmarks. Metrics include Dice (%) and Hausdorff Distance (HD). Bold indicates the best performance and underline denotes the second best.
